title: Great app, but very buggy on Apple Watch
body:
I believe this app is amazing, especially for my ADHD mind. It helped me build a daily routine to stick to. 

However, on the apple watch it turns off the moment you leave the app or the screen gets dimmer. Afterwards if I want to continue with the routine, I have to restart the whole thing again.

 I try to leave my phone behind for my morning routines, so this is a gamechanger. If there will be a fix, I'll change the rating to 5 stars again!
